name: GoDaddy
outlook:
What GoDaddy says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueFor the full year ending December 31, 2026, GoDaddy expects to finish toward the higher end of its revenue range of $5.215 billion to $5.255 billion.
  • Full year 2026: NEBITDA marginFor the full year ending December 31, 2026, GoDaddy reaffirms its NEBITDA margin target of over 33% .
  • Full year 2026: free cash flowFor the full year ending December 31, 2026, GoDaddy reaffirms its free cash flow target of approximately $1.8 billion, versus the $1.6 billion of free cash flow generated in 2025.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
